New Zealand Nationals 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2023 will crown the National Champions in 16 WCA official events, over the course of 3 days.

Hay un límite de 100 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2023#29292-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2023#29293-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).

* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

***

* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

## FMC Canada 2023
### [EN]
This competition is **Canada's championship for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves** as we will not hold the event at [Canadian Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CanadianChampionship2023). The top-three Canadian competitors will be recognized for the national podium.

This competition will have competitors simultaneously competing in 3x3x3 Fewest Moves at different locations across Canada with one winner.

This isn't your typical speed solving competition as 3x3x3 Fewest Moves is the only event. This is an **exam-style event** in which competitors spend up to an hour finding the shortest solution they can and **writing it down on paper**. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 speed solving event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada).
### [FR]
Cette compétition est le **Championnat canadien de 3x3x3 résolution optimisée (ou FMC)** car nous n'organiserons pas cette épreuve lors du [Championnat canadien 2023] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CanadianChampionship2023). Les trois premiers compétiteurs canadiens seront reconnus pour le podium national.

Dans le cadre de cette compétition, des compétiteurs participeront simultanément à l'épreuve du 3x3x3 résolution optimisée à différents endroits au Canada et un seul gagnant sera désigné.

Il ne s'agit pas d'une compétition typique où il faut résoudre le plus vite possible, car la seule épreuve est le 3x3x3 résolution optimisée. Il s'agit d'une **épreuve de type examen** au cours de laquelle les compétiteurs passent jusqu'à une heure à trouver la solution la plus courte possible et à **l'écrire sur papier**. Si vous cherchez à participer à une compétition de speedcubing plus classique, merci de chercher [une autre compétition au Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada).

Parents and spectators are welcome to help out with volunteer tasks as well.

Speecubes.co.za and CubeCo, South Africa's local cube stores, who will be sponsoring prize money and store vouchers for the competition's winners.

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 7 seconds or 5 minutes.

This year there will be a 3-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2023).

### This year's UK National Championship


##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Spectators and Guests](#22468-spectators-and-guests) tab.

If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

**Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Kewbz UK Championship 2022, you'll receive a completely free UK Championship t-shirt as a memento! You will receive this on registration at the venue, where you can choose your size.

**Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. items.information:
Registration is full now. You can still register, but you will be placed on a waiting list and you can only compete if other people cancel. So your chances are small.

==================

This is the first WCA competition in Uzbekistan. We hope after this competition many more will follow.

Around 1-2 weeks before the competition you will receive an email to confirm your participation. Please make sure to check your mailbox and spam box around that time. If you do not confirm, then you will removed from the list of competitors.

You can pay the registration fee on-site in the venue.

==========

Это первые соревнования WCA в Узбекистане. Мы надеемся, что после этого соревнования последуют много других.

Примерно за 1-2 недели до начала соревнования вы получите электронное письмо, чтобы подтвердить свое участие. Обязательно проверяйте свой почтовый ящик и спам за 1-2 недели до соревнований. Если участие не будет подтверждено то участник будет удален из списка конкурсантов.

Вы можете оплатить регистрационный сбор на месте в месте проведения.

==========

Bu Uzbekistondagi birinchi WCA musobaqalari. Umid qilamiz-ki, bu musobaqadan keyin, boshqa koplab musobaqlar amalga oshiriladi.

Ishtirokingizni tasdiqlash uchun musobaqadan 1-2 hafta oldin elektron pochta olasiz. Musoboqadan 1-2 hafta oldin pochtangizni va spam papkasini tekshirib turing. Ishtirokchi qatnashishini tasdiqlamasa, qatnashuvchilar ro'yxatidan o'chiriladi.

items.information:
Pris og registrering
Registreringen koster 100 dkr, og er forudbetalt.
Der er plads til 90 deltagere
Transport
Tog til Roskilde st. Og så Bus 123 mod Valby eller 600S mod Hillerød til Ros torv (stopper lige udenfor venue). Tjek rejseplanen.dk
Regelsæt
Denne konkurrence følger WCA regelsættet, det er derfor forventet at alle deltager er bekendt med dette. Alle deltagere er derfor også underforstået med at deres resultater vil blive publiceret på WCA's hjemmeside, inklusiv navn, nationalitet og køn.
Betalingspolitik
Aflysning: 
Hvis du tilmelder dig konkurrencen, men du ikke kan komme og du informerer os via e-mail, før den 3. juni, 2016 vil vi overføre halvdelen af ​​den betalte afgift tilbage.

Redigering registrering: fjerne events: Skriv en mail med hvilke events du vil fjernes fra før 3. juni 2016.
Registreringer uden betalinger: De registreringer uden betaling, vil blive slettet efter tilmeldingsfristen. (3. juni 2016.)
Acceptering af registreringer: Vi betragter en registrering for gyldig, når registreringen er færdig, og tilmeldingsgebyret er betalt. Vi vil først acceptere tilmeldingen efter begge disse betingelser er opfyldt.
Overnatning
Plads til 70 personer til overnatning på venue.
Det er først til mølle princippet, og det er gratis.
Kontakt Camilla (fam.nielsson@gmail.com )
Indkvartering kan fra fredag aften.
Man kan overnatte fra fredag til søndag.
